record.question: The diameter of the wheel is 70cm. It moves slowly along a road. How far will it go in 5 revolutions?
record.explanation: Circumference=πd=(22/7)×70=220 cm. Five revolutions cover 5×220=1,100 cm, option B, using the conventional π=22/7 and rolling without slipping. Verified worked solution; unofficial.
